item.title: Alex Honnold Answers (Pretty Much) All Your Questions About Rock Climbing
item.description: Alex Honnold sat down with WIRED to answer a few questions posed from random internet strangers. He delivered some interesting responses.

item.title: Bondi Surfers Hold Paddle-Out In Honor of Mass Shooting Victims
item.description: As Sydney reels from a horrific mass shooting that took place in Bondi, hundreds of surfers held a ceremonial paddle-out to pay tribute to the victims.

item.title: New Film, ‘Dig,’ Examines Snowboarder Ryland Bell’s Deep Commitment to Riding Alaskan Spines
item.description: In "Dig," snowboarder Ryland Bell and a team of filmmakers charge steep Alaskan lines in some of the most remote terrain on the planet. And try to explain why.

item.title: Peak 2 Peak: How Whistler’s $52-Million Gondola Was Built Will Blow Your Mind
item.description: If you've ridden British Columbia's Whistler Blackcomb, you know the Peak 2 Peak gondola. The views make it easy to forget what a marvel of engineering it is.

item.title: Watch the Underwater Volcano Nicknamed ‘Sharkcano’ Erupt With Immense Power
item.description: Kavachi, an underwater volcano off the Solomon Islands, erupted in spectacular fashion, and this guy was close by to capture it all on camera.

item.title: Mount Everest Is the Deadliest Climb on Earth: Every Fatal Section Explained
item.description: Mount Everest is the "Mount Everest" of mountains. But getting to the top might kill you in a variety of ways. Shall we count them all?

item.title: Video: Hundreds of Skiers Trapped in Dolomites Due to Lack of Snow
item.description: Hundreds of Dolomites skiers found themselves stuck at the top of the mountain and at the mercy of lift operators, due to unseasonably warm weather.

item.title: This Is What the South Bay of Los Angeles Looks Like When the Surf Gets Heavy
item.description: This wasn’t the biggest day ever in the South Bay of Los Angeles, but it was heavy. A significant swell hit El Porto and a few surfers caught great waves.

item.title: Filipe Toledo Wants Olympic Medal, Says Not Winning Another World Title Won’t Hurt His Legacy
item.description: Filipe Toledo spoke to Brazilian media about his desire to win an Olympic medal and made it clear he doesn’t need a third world title to validate his career.

item.title: This Bright Pink, 11’6” Surfboard Mysteriously Went Missing in Nazaré; the Police Laughed
item.description: After changing out of his wetsuit in Nazaré, Portugal, Pete Shaw walked back to grab the pink surfboard he’d left 50 feet from his car. It was gone.
